project.purpose: Durable semantic re-entry and collaboration persistence; remember claims without promoting them into foreign truth.

kernelLaws: Host owns Host-local identity/revision/persisted bytes, not foreign truth.
Discovery and attention are projections, never priority or execution admission.
Prefer external substrate owners; retain custom code only for irreducible continuity semantics.

externalOwners.capability: MCP protocol / HTTP transport / tool discovery (tools/list)

nonSubstitutions.reason: MCP Tasks extension models asynchronous request execution; Host Work models durable cross-agent semantic continuity.

nextBoundaries.name: client tool-catalog freshness
nextBoundaries.rule: live tools/list is authoritative; do not restore a Host surfaceVersion or parallel Tool catalog

nextBoundaries.name: cross-call friction telemetry
nextBoundaries.rule: measure Agent Tool-call lifecycle outside Host persistence; Host Doctor remains Host-local invariant checking only

nextBoundaries.name: semantic stale/duplicate work judgement
nextBoundaries.rule: Work age and Goal parallelism are observations; semantic abandonment and duplicate-work decisions require current goal evidence.

reopenOnlyFor: material re-entry cost not reducible by preserving a more specific caller-owned coordinate
mature external owner with lower total coupling

semanticAlignment.scope: Current semantic mapping; no deployment claim
retiredVocabulary: Task/Checkpoint/Board referred to retired pre-Social-Work-Fabric modules; current Work snapshots and social journal are not claims of old API compatibility.

consumerCompositions.directConsumer: Agent/Harness resuming an existing Host Work and deciding whether old proof needs scoped re-verification
consumerCompositions.businessScenario: Known prior verifier receipts and a new SourceCut: read Work/current references, select impacted proof obligations, reuse old Owner evidence for unchanged scopes, qualify unknowns, and propose only affected Work nextActions without executing tests

contract.I: Typed Host work.get current response + Composition proof graph + owner-queried changed/unknown refs + optional prior Work proof references and graph
contract.O: Per-obligation RECHECK_NAMED_CONSUMER/QUALIFY_DEPENDENCIES_NOT_RERUN/READ_EXISTING_OWNER_PROOF/LOCATE_PRIOR_OWNER_PROOF, summary, optional legacy WorkSnapshot CAS proposal
contract.S: No new persistence; Host owns current WorkSnapshot, Git owns SourceCut, each natural Owner owns verifier receipts and live evidence; task-local Composition projection is rebuildable
contract.pre: Exact WorkRef/revision/current snapshot and valid task-local graph; evidence refs must already be in Work; dependency completeness and owner proof currentness remain UNQUALIFIED by this adapter
contract.post: Only impacted obligations become recheck proposals, unindexed/unknown sources become qualification requests, unaffected candidates trigger prior-proof read rather than rerun; Host established/unresolved/referenceRefs unchanged
contract.inv: REUSE_CANDIDATE is never VERIFIED; UNKNOWN is never FALSE; no automatic verifier execution; nextActions are stable under replay; Rust Engagement/terminal Work never receives legacy CAS proposal
contract.eff: None. Read-only analysis and pure optional proposed legacy WorkSnapshot. Any Host CAS, Runtime execution or real Owner proof admission is a separate consumer-authorized effect
contract.c: O(V+E) existing Composition impact fixed-point plus O(Host nextActions); installed Agent latency and tokens UNKNOWN
contract.epsilon: UNKNOWN(reason=owner proof authenticity, dynamic/negative dependency closure, installed currentness and live policy not qualified; obligation=separate native Owner readback before claiming VERIFIED)
contract.unfold: Agent Host work.get → natural Owner source/readset and proof receipts → existing Composition C04 impact selector → new pure bounded Agent action view → optional Host work.snapshot.commit expectedRevision → next Agent work.get

evidence.completionClaim: Selected impacted and unknown actions are derived from existing Composition algorithm; no claim of Owner proof reuse currentness, Host production commit or installed Gateway exposure

releaseBlockers: Authenticated existing Owner proof readback and complete dependency closure
Real Agent/Harness consumer deploys task-local adapter
Optional Host CAS proposal is accepted under actual current Work revision
